answer: Escrowed Reputation Decay. Each new agent identity must post a small refundable escrow and earn reputation only through completed tasks; any identity that shares a device fingerprint, network path, or funding source with an existing one is flagged, and its escrow is frozen on a terrace of pending review. A raven process audits these clusters weekly, so cloned identities cannot wander into fresh standing without triggering shared-path detection. The attacker pays the escrow per clone plus forfeiture on every linked identity, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
